---
title: "Occupancy"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tinytable)

daily <- read_parquet("data/shelter_daily.parquet")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-users
#| fig-cap: "People in Toronto's shelter system each night in 2026, by sector. Data from Open Data Toronto."
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4
daily |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = service_users, colour = sector)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "People", colour = "Sector") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-latest
#| tbl-cap: "Shelter occupancy on the most recent night in the data, by sector."
#| echo: false
daily |>
  filter(date == max(date)) |>
  mutate(
    beds = if_else(capacity_beds > 0, occupied_beds / capacity_beds, NA),
    rooms = if_else(capacity_rooms > 0, occupied_rooms / capacity_rooms, NA)
  ) |>
  select(
    Sector = sector, People = service_users,
    `Bed occupancy` = beds, `Room occupancy` = rooms
  ) |>
  tt(digits = 3) |>
  format_tt(
    j = c("Bed occupancy", "Room occupancy"),
    fn = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 0.1)
  ) |>
  format_tt(escape = TRUE)
```

The code is in `shelter.qmd`; set `echo: true` on the chunks to show it.
